headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service facility in Atlanta, Georgia, after the late civil rights leader John R. Lewis.
what_it_does: The law designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3900 Crown Road Southwest in Atlanta as the John R. Lewis Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how the post office operates or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 4, 2022.
